Commentary.Commentary: Williamson-Taylor both got to their fifties and did the job for their side. The idea in the morning was to give some rest to their bowlers who by now should be fit and fine. A minimum of 26 overs are remaining today and it will be highly interesting to see if the home side can replicate what they did for the last two days. Join us for the run chase in a bit.

The Kiwi batsmen are heading towards the dressing room and this indicates - NEW ZEALAND HAVE DECLARED FOR 166/2 and have set a gigantic target of 387 runs in front of the Rhodesians. They didn't get the best of the starts as both their openers got out early but Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor, the ever dependable duo came to the fore and picked up the pace after a slow start.
Taylor sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.

SIX! ROSS THE BOSS! Tossed up ball around middle, Taylor gets down on one knee and brings his strong bottom hand into play as he slog sweeps it off the meat of the bat and over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. The fielder there was a mute spectator.
Tossed up around middle, swept through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Williamson gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Loopy ball around off, Williamson gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary. NZ in some really hurry here!
GRAEME CREMER into the attack!
Full toss on middle, Williamson hits it towards long on and is lucky as the ball falls short of the fielder there. A single is taken.
Another full ball outside off, Taylor slams it through covers for one.
SIX! That's tonked! Fuller length delivery on middle, Taylor walks across and absolutely murders this over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Very full and outside off, Taylor looks to give a whack but gets an outside edge towards third man for a couple.
Yorker outside off, Taylor looks to slice it through the off side but misses.
Fuller length ball outside off, Taylor comes across and hits it back to the bowler.
Wide! Fuller length delivery wide outside off, it's left alone.
25th Test fifty for Ross Taylor.
On the pads, Taylor flicks it off his pads to square leg for a single. That is another Test fifty for Ross.
A stumping appeal is referred upstairs.

Not out! Tossed up ball outside off, Taylor looks to push it through covers but gets beaten. Moor whips of the bails and ask for a stumping. The TV umpire sees the replay and turns it down. Taylor is all safe.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.
On the pads, Taylor looks to flick but is hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball on off, Taylor deliberately plays it to third man for a brace.
The ball has gone out of shape and the umpires are looking at it through 8-shape gauge.
SIX! Clobbered! Tossed up ball on off, Taylor slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full ball on off, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Over covers! Full ball outside off, Kane sees it in his radar and launches it over covers for a boundary.
On the leg stump, played to the leg side for a brace.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Wide! Too full and wide outside off, Taylor looks to cut that but was out of his reach. Wide signaled by the umpire.
FOUR! Fuller ball on the pads, Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Welcome back for the final session, folks! How much more will KANE WILLIAMSOM and TOM LATHAM add to this lead? Let's wait and fins out. MICHAEL CHINOUYA to bowl first up...
... Day 4, Session 3...

The hosts' bowling was on the money from the word go and pressurized the opposition for quick runs. Tiripano and Chinouya picked up early wickets by sharing one apiece amongst themselves. After that, they had no success coming their way. The spin bowling was not effective and gave away runs. Will new Zealand declare now? Do join us for the final session to find out.

The Kiwis have played well to strengthen their lead. Starting their 2nd innings to post a good target for the hosts, the visiting side lost 2 quick wickets of their openers. The New Zealand captain Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor played sensibly and added 88 runs together. The former made yet another Test fifty to solidify their lead to 338 runs.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Williamson gets forward and defends it into the ground. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 4!
On middle and leg, Taylor drives it down to long on for a single.
An arm ball around off, Taylor gets back and cuts it late behind point for a couple.
Loopy ball around leg, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

KW has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR LEG BYES! Loopy ball around middle and off, Williamson looks to defend it off the back foot but misses and so does the keeper and slip for a boundary.
On middle and leg, driven towards mid on for a single.

KW paddles the ball down the leg side.
Outside off, Williamson looks to play at it but misses.
Taylor comes down the track to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the short leg fielder.
Driven back to the bowler.

What a player! This guy is unstoppable! On the pads again, flicked towards backward square leg for a single.

Drinks are on the field...
FOUR! Two in two! Length ball on off, Kane puts in his bat to block that but the ball goes off the outside edge through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.

OUT! The fielding change has worked for the home side! Chinouya dishes out a short ball in the channel on off, Guptill gets back to punch it on the off side but the ball bounces off the deck a bit and that takes the Kiwi opener by surprise. It goes off the outer part of the bat towards gully where Nyumbu takes a sharp reflex catch. The hosts are not letting the Kiwis take a burp after lunch. Brilliant display on the field and both the openers are back in the hut!
Slips are removed now and only a gully in place now...
On a length and outside off, Williamson turns it towards mid on and says WAIT ON to his partner who was in search for a single.
Good length ball on off, Martin punches this off the back foot towards covers and scampers across for a quick single.
Short of a length delivery, at 128 kph. Guptill lets it go through him.
Tad short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
KANE WILLIAMSON is the new man in!

OUT! Edged and that's gone! Donald draws first blood! On a length and around off, very little movement in that probing zone. Latham feels for it and as a result goes after it with a push. Gets an outside edge and Moor behind the stumps makes no mistake.
SIX! Whattey shot! Angles a length delivery on middle, at 127 kph. Latham swivels a bit and pulls it through backward square leg for a biggie all the way. Nicely done!
FOUR! Smashed! You can't bowl him there, that's his beloved zone! Fuller length delivery on off, Guptill absolutely smokes it through the carpet towards covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautifully done! On a length and outside off, Guptill prods forward, opens the face of the bat and steers it past gully for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, driven straight to covers.
Fuller ball on off, Latham lunges forward and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Tad full and outside off, Latham presses forward and defends it down.
Fuller length delivery outside off, driven past covers for a single.
MICHAEL CHINOUYA to bowl from the other end!
Landed on off, Latham looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat and back to Donald.
Good length delivery on middle, Tom answers with a straight bat.
Fuller length delivery, nipping in as well. Latham looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Can't be given out lbw as it was pitched outside leg.
Tad short on leg, Latham looks to flick it across the line but misses and gets hit on the body.
Pitches it up and slants it across, Latham makes a watchful leave for Moor.

Wide! Starts with a full length delivery wide outside off, Guptill has nothing to with that one. The umpire calls it a wide as it was way outside off.
Welcome back for the second session. Not much to talk about as New Zealand have just started their innings. TOM LATHAM and MARTIN GUPTILL to start again. DONALD TIRIPANO will steam in first up...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

After bundling out Zimbabwe for 362 and gaining a grand lead of 220 runs, Kane Williamson opted to bat again so that his bowlers can take some rest. In the given 3 overs, the openers negotiated well. The pitch is absolutely dead and a long tiring day beckons the hosts' bowlers. But if they can come up with a beauty of a spell, you never know anything can happen. Join us in a short while for the afternoon session.
Full ball on off, Latham tries to drive it away but it goes on to hit his pads off an inside edge. THAT IS LUNCH ON DAY 4!
